comment: The component catalogue does not adequately represent the wider workflow of research institutions. MakBRC-type institutions support grant and project management, clinical research, procurement, equipment management, ICT operations, LIMS, BIMS, research data management, analysis and reporting.

public.text: The component catalogue does not adequately represent the wider workflow of research institutions. MakBRC-type institutions support grant and project management, clinical research, procurement, equipment management, ICT operations, LIMS, BIMS, research data management, analysis and reporting.
public.suggestedRevision: Recognise these as connected functional applications that may consume or contribute to DPI-H services while remaining outside the central foundational layer.
